def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    nonbg=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    def isolated(r,c):
        return all((rr,cc) not in set(nonbg) for rr,cc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)))
    markers=[(r,c) for r,c in nonbg if isolated(r,c)]
    templ=[(r,c) for r,c in nonbg if not isolated(r,c)]
    # template color: the color at template cells (assuming single color besides internal accents)
    # keep template cells' own colors as offsets: store (dr,dc,color)
    r0,c0=templ[0]
    offs=[(r-r0,c-c0,g[r][c]) for r,c in templ]
    rows=[o[0] for o in offs]; cols=[o[1] for o in offs]
    cr=(min(rows)+max(rows))//2; cc=(min(cols)+max(cols))//2
    for r,c in markers:
        for dr,dc,col in offs:
            rr,rc=r+dr-cr, c+dc-cc
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=rc<W:
                g[rr][rc]=col
    return g
